listing.name: CrownPark Xbox 360 Native Ports Collection
listing.summary: Get a title-specific Windows or Linux launcher from CrownPark and import your own Xbox 360 game files.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are on hold for this collection while we verify the shader cache described in the Split/Second release notes. You can use the guide with a launcher you have permission to use.

steps.title: Choose your game’s launcher
steps.instruction: Find the release for your game in the upstream project and read that release’s source and testing notes. Extract its Windows x86-64 ZIP or Linux x86-64 .tar.zst to a separate folder for that game. Both platforms need a Vulkan-capable driver. On Linux, follow the upstream guide for gamescope, Python 3 and archive tools.

steps.title: Import your original files and play
steps.instruction: On Windows, open Launcher.bat and choose Import game files. For a disc title, use the matching disc image or extracted files. For an XBLA title, use an extracted game folder containing default.xex. On Linux, run ./run.sh, select the matching title and follow its import prompt for the disc or XBLA package. Use the edition and region in the bundle’s content/SOURCE.txt. Resolve any checksum warning before playing.

steps.title: Keep each game’s saves and settings
steps.instruction: Keep the user-data folder beside each launcher. Back it up before replacing or removing that game’s extracted folder. Keep your original disc image or XBLA package outside the launcher folder.

warnings: Upstream testing varies by title and platform. Check the notes for the package you choose.

original_game_review.reason: The collection publishes title-specific launchers for multiple Xbox360 games; each selected bundle has its own SOURCE.txt original identity. This umbrella record has no one original-game scope.
